err_rate: Twitch is limiting requests for now.
err_network: Twitch is not answering right now.
err_config_affiliate: Paying subscribers: only for Affiliate or Partner channels.
conn_why: To count your followers and paying subscribers, Twitch must first ask for your consent.
reconnect: Twitch no longer accepts your authorization.
disconnected: Channel disconnected: Twitch can no longer be read with this permission.
disconnectedOffline: Channel disconnected here, but Twitch could not be told. To be sure, remove the access in Twitch (Settings, then Connections).
needHttps: Your site's address must start with https:// for Twitch to accept the connection.
chooseOne: Tick at least one number to follow (followers or paying subscribers), then save.
res_denied: You declined the permission at Twitch. Click “Connect my Twitch channel” again, then “Authorize”.
res_refused: Twitch refused the connection. Check your Twitch application in the Twitch connector (ID, secret and redirect address), then try again.
res_network: Twitch is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.
res_rate: Twitch is limiting requests for now. Try again in a few minutes.
res_expired: The connection link had expired (10 minutes). Click “Connect my Twitch channel” again.
res_wrongAccount: You signed in at Twitch with the account “{login}”, which is not this channel's. Sign in again with the right Twitch account.
res_scope: A permission is missing at Twitch. Try again and leave every box ticked.
cb_invalid: This connection link is no longer valid. Go back to your site's administration and click “Connect my Twitch channel” again.
stat_hours_watched: Time watched by your viewers, in minutes (30 days)
stat_followers_gained: Followers gained during your lives (30 days)
live_trouble: Twitch is not answering right now.
live_bestTitle: The game that makes you gain the most followers
live_bestNone: Not enough lives yet to compare your games: at least 1 hour live on a game is needed.
live_videosNone: No video found on your channel.
live_videosError: The views of your videos are not available: Twitch is not answering.
live_videosStale: Last known views: Twitch is not answering.
live_eraseConfirm: Erase the {n} measured lives? Tracking starts again from zero.
conn_why_chat: For the bot to read and answer in your chat, Twitch must first ask for your consent.
notReadyConnector: The Twitch application is not set up: open the Twitch connector.
noConnector: The Twitch connector is not installed: nothing is read from Twitch (live, clips, figures).
suggestReason: connects your site to Twitch (live, clips, figures of your channel)
handover_conflict: This channel used another Twitch application. Reconnect it: the authorization given to the other application is removed.
handover_incomplete: The Twitch application could not be carried over completely: complete it in the Twitch connector.
cb_noConnector: The Twitch connector is not installed. Install it from the administration, then click “Connect my Twitch channel” again.
cb_down: Your site could not finish the connection. Go back to the administration and click “Connect my Twitch channel” again.
connectorMissing: The Twitch connector is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
events_empty: No upcoming appointment in your Twitch schedule. Add your streams on Twitch (Dashboard, Schedule) to see them here.
events_setup_channel: Enter your channel name in the Twitch channel settings to see your Twitch schedule.
events_setup_connector: To see your Twitch schedule, set up the site's Twitch application in the Twitch connector.
events_setup_refused: Twitch refuses the site's application: check its credentials on the Twitch connector page.
events_setup_update: To see your Twitch schedule, update the Twitch connector (Extensions, Check for updates).
frozen: Some figures are frozen: Twitch refuses the current authorization.
forget_confirm: Forget the carried-over channel? This module no longer knows your channel until you type it in the settings.
disconnect_confirm: Disconnect your channel? Your figures from Twitch stop until you connect it again.
conn_none: Your channel is not connected to Twitch.
